promptText: In your blood-hunger, you destroy someone close to you. Kill a mortal Character. Create a mortal if none are available. Take the skill Bloodthirsty.
reasoning: 1a: kill a mortal Character (strike out, not check), take the skill Bloodthirsty, record one Experience. Piero Sagredo is the mortal closest to hand at the furnace and the one who trusts me. The Experience goes into Memory IV, which is already the Piero/La Nona memory.

operations.name: Bloodthirsty
operations.description: the hunger arrives before the thought does, and my hands are already moving

operations.text: The first hunger takes me at the wood-yard gate and I drink Piero Sagredo empty against the stacked billets, his tools still in my pocket; I row what is left out in La Nona and let it down into the channel off San Michele, and the fog takes it as easily as it took the sand.

experiences.text: I am Domenego Zulian, born in the Venetian parish of San Zulian in the year of Our Lord 1268; in my twenty-third year the Grand Council drove all the furnaces out of the city onto Murano for fear of fire, and I went with the fires, a glassblower with soot in his lungs and no name worth carving.

Marina Zulian holds her hand in the glory hole of The Furnace at Calle dei Conterie until the wardens admit no woman could fake such a burn for a lie; I bind her wrist in the water trough and say nothing, because Guild Silence is the only inheritance our father left me.
Fra Ludovico pays me in candle-ends and absolution for a phial of blood-red cristallo; Reading the Fire, I draw it out the instant the manganese clears, and he weeps at the colour of it.
I teach Piero Sagredo to row La Nona blind through the lagoon fog to San Michele, and when he asks what is wrapped in the wet sailcloth under the thwart I tell him it is sand.

The first hunger takes me at the wood-yard gate and I drink Piero Sagredo empty against the stacked billets, his tools still in my pocket; I row what is left out in La Nona and let it down into the channel off San Michele, and the fog takes it as easily as it took the sand.
Zoe Kalamare steps into the mouth of the furnace and beckons me after her, and when I take her hands in the fire my Glazed Hands come out cool while everything human in me burns off like dross.

reasoning: 1c: create the immortal captor (Hakim Nasir al-Zujaji of Aleppo); check a Skill (Glassblowing — the craft he kept me for and the flaw that freed me); take Humans are Cattle; take a Resource used for evil in his service (The Pelican of Aleppo); strike out all mortal Characters as a hundred years pass. Fra Ludovico and Piero Sagredo were already struck out; Sabiha bint Yusuf, the housekeeper of the century of servitude, is struck out now — she was created during this turn because the app refused to load the save at all until a third mortal-typed Character existed (see README). One Experience, into Memory I, the memory of the craft owning me.
